units.source_text: 报社和日本棋院有关人士，同东京的川岛博士，以及宫下的冈岛医师商量之后，

en.t: After the people concerned at the newspaper and the Nihon Ki-in had consulted with Dr. Kawashima in Tokyo and Dr. Okajima, Miyashita's physician,

units.source_text: 决定按照名人的意愿，让他继续对局。

en.t: they decided to follow the Master's wishes and allow him to continue the match.

units.source_text: 但由原先每隔五天一轮，一天五个小时对局，

en.t: But instead of the previous schedule of one session every five days, with five hours of play in a day,

units.source_text: 缩短成每隔三四天一轮，一天两个半小时对局，

en.t: it was shortened to one session every three or four days, with two and a half hours of play in a day,
in order to lessen the Master's fatigue.

units.source_text: 每次对局前后，还要接受医生的诊视，得到医生同意才能弈战。

en.t: Before and after each session, he also had to be examined by a doctor, and he could play only after receiving the doctor's approval.
